name: Euro-Camp Wilder Kaiser
beschreibung: The Euro-Camp Wilder Kaiser is located in Kössen in the Kaiserwinkl region. The site lies near the Wilder Kaiser, surrounded by mountain scenery. In summer, the surrounding paths are suitable for hiking, while in winter nearby ski areas make skiing possible. The site offers pitches for motorhomes and caravans, equipped with electric hookups. The sanitary facilities include showers and toilets. The location is characterized by quiet. Here, guests will find a tourist base station with simple infrastructure in nature.
